productIntent.goal: AI-native, modular, industry-agnostic Enterprise Operating System where enterprise activity can be executed, explained, replayed, upgraded, and continuously evolved.

currentStage.name: Three Core Financial Statements
currentStage.businessGoal: Project authoritative GL and BusinessData lineage into Balance Sheet, Income Statement and Cash Flow Statement with cross-statement reconciliation and deterministic regeneration.

activeRequirementSet.name: Balance Sheet + Income Statement + Cash Flow Statement
acceptance: Balance Sheet is derived from ending GL balances and versioned statement mappings
Income Statement is derived from period GL movements and versioned statement mappings
Cash Flow Statement classifies cash-equivalent Journal movements using BusinessData lineage and CashFlowClassificationRule
cash movement without lineage is rejected from statement projection
unclassified or ambiguously classified cash movement is rejected
statement hierarchy and subtotal lines are deterministic
Income Statement net income equals Balance Sheet current-period earnings presentation
Opening Cash + Net Cash Change equals Closing Cash
Cash Flow closing cash equals Balance Sheet cash
each statement projection has a stable semantic digest
re-projecting the same facts/rules/mappings yields identical digest
broken statement mappings are detected by cross-statement reconciliation
financial statements remain derived projections and do not rewrite BusinessData or GL
verified: FAI-01/02 strict double-entry is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED
FAI-03~05 recognition / trace / Trial Balance / GL Replay is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED
FAI-06 period governance / economic↔GL reconciliation / statement metadata is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED by PR #48 / CI #670
Asloop semantics confirm statements as account/ledger projections
deferred: ownership-equity statement beyond core three reports

antiOverdesignQuestions: Which confirmed current requirement needs this?
What acceptance gate is blocked if we do not build it now?
Can an existing mechanism satisfy the need more simply?
Is this current necessity or mainly hypothetical future flexibility?
alignmentTriggers: every 3 completed verified work packets since last alignment
proposal to generalize a local mechanism

lastAlignment.reason: EEL-C04 completed and mandatory completed-loop requirement-alignment trigger fired.
lastAlignment.result: EEL-C05 Inventory Transfer selected because it adds a new internal-asset conservation proof without requiring statutory accounting expansion or WMS/TMS platformization.

alignmentCadence.countingRule: Count merged bounded slices whose evidence level is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED or CERTIFIED.
alignmentCadence.triggerRule: Run formal alignment at the third slice or any mandatory event trigger, whichever comes first.
alignmentCadence.resetRule: Reset the slice counter after a formal alignment review is recorded in lastAlignment.

nextRequirementSelection.rule: Complete the three core statements first. After certification, reassess remaining statutory-accounting gaps separately; do not turn the report layer into a second accounting engine.

findings: legacy Asloop/bookkeeping semantics include explicit debit/credit concepts
current EVO generic ledger uses signed quantity/amount and does not enforce balanced journals
financial accounting must be layered as an explicit General Ledger projection rather than forcing operational ledgers into debit/credit terminology
invariants: each General Ledger journal has at least one debit and one credit line
sum(debit) equals sum(credit) under pinned accounting precision
financial statements derive from authoritative accounting state and never rewrite canonical BusinessData
